title: ClearFront: extract js/input.js (card preview gestures)
description: Final decomposition slice per DEC-CF-007. Move only the self-contained initCardPeek hover/touch preview IIFE into app/js/input.js behind CF.installInputModule(), invoked at the same inline-host ordering point. Keep host action/modal/scrollbar wiring and bootstrap inline. No rules, balance, source, or baseline changes.
acceptance_criteria: The initCardPeek desktop-hover and touch-hold IIFE moves without behavior changes into app/js/input.js behind CF.installInputModule(), invoked at the exact former ordering point.
input.js adds no ctx keys or mutable shared bindings; host action/modal/scrollbar wiring and showDeckSelect bootstrap remain inline.
app/index.html still opens directly through file://; desktop hover and touch-hold preview checks pass with zero console errors/exceptions.
Champion-select screenshots are byte-identical and the released seeded combat/blocking plus undo regressions still pass.
node --check passes for all app JS files and the remaining inline host; source and baseline hashes remain unchanged.
